headlines.title: Shopify CEO says employees’ ‘slop grenades’ are making more work for everyone else
headlines.summary: He said AI is helping workers produce more output, but the quality of it is so bad that their colleagues have to spend more time fixing it

headlines.title: The E-Commerce Stocks to Buy Before the Holiday Quarter
headlines.summary: One of these companies earns more than 40% of its annual operating profit in the holiday quarter. But it's not the stock I'd buy first.

headlines.title: Shopify Merchants Could Get AI Orders Without Shoppers Visiting Their Websites
headlines.summary: Meta's new AI shopping agent can place orders on a shopper's behalf without them ever visiting a merchant's website, and Shopify sits right in the middle of that transaction flow. Whether that position is a windfall or a slow erosion of merchant power depends on terms nobody has disclosed yet.

headlines.title: Down 25%, Is Shopify Stock a Better Buy than SpaceX and the "Magnificent Seven" Stocks in September?
headlines.summary: Shopify leads in its niche, but it may not necessarily compare well to all the tech giants.

headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP) Stock Looks Reasonable With Cash Flow Doing Most Of The Work
headlines.summary: Shopify has given long term holders a powerful ride over the past few years, yet the stock is currently down over shorter windows, which naturally raises a simple question for anyone looking at the chart today: Do the cash flows that Shopify can generate over time really support where the share price now sits, or has sentiment moved ahead of the underlying math? Over the past 3 years the stock has gained 122.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
